workflow.critical: All report content must be verified against {reporting_language}
Execute ALL steps in exact order

step.goal: Resolve suite name from argument or active suite in test-suites.yml

check.if: no suite name argument is provided
file does not exist or active_suite is empty
check.output: ❌ No active suite found. Run /aiqa-analyzestory --suite <name> first.

step.action: Find the suite entry where name = {suite_name}

check.output: ⚠️ Suite status is "{current_status}" — report may not have been generated yet. Continuing validation; artifact checks will catch missing files.

step.goal: Load report files and ground-truth from junit.xml and bug-reports/
step.action: Record expected report paths: - HTML: {output_folder}/{story_id}/reports/qa-report.html - XLSX: {output_folder}/{story_id}/reports/qa-report.xlsx - MD: {output_folder}/{story_id}/reports/qa-report.md
Count {actual_bug_count} = number of BUG-XXXX.md files in {output_folder}/{story_id}/bug-reports/
If each report file exists: read it; extract the pass rate and bug count values stated in the report
step.output: 📂 Validating: {output_folder}/{story_id}/reports/ Ground truth — Pass rate: {actual_pass_rate}% | Bugs: {actual_bug_count} | Tests: {total_tests}

step.goal: Run all quality checks and collect issues
step.check: All 3 report files exist at the correct paths (HTML, XLSX, MD)
Pass rate stated in the report matches {actual_pass_rate}% computed from junit.xml — NOT a placeholder or stale value
Bug count stated in the report matches {actual_bug_count} files in bug-reports/ — NOT an estimate or placeholder
All {total_tests} test results (both passed and failed) are listed in the report — no tests omitted
Quality gate result (PASSED / FAILED) is clearly stated in all three report formats, referencing the {min_pass_rate}% threshold
HTML report renders valid HTML — opening and closing tags balanced, no broken structure, no unclosed divs or tables
MD report contains all required sections: executive summary, pass rate, failed test list, bug severity breakdown, next recommended actions
All report content (headings, labels, body text) is in {reporting_language} — no content in another language

step.goal: Present validation report and ask how to proceed
step.output:
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ 🔍 Validation Report — /aiqa-generatereport ║ ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
Suite : {suite_name} Output : {output_folder}/{story_id}/reports/ Pass rate : {actual_pass_rate}% (threshold: {min_pass_rate}%) Bug count : {actual_bug_count}
🔴 Critical ({critical_count}): (for each Critical issue: " • {id} — {description}" + actual vs reported value) (if none: " None")
🟠 High ({high_count}): (for each High issue: " • {id} — {description}" + detail) (if none: " None")
🟡 Medium ({medium_count}): (for each Medium issue: " • {id} — {description}") (if none: " None")
🔵 Low ({low_count}): (for each Low issue: " • {id} — {description}") (if none: " None")
Total issues: {total_issues}
step.ask: How would you like to proceed? A) Fix ALL {total_issues} issue(s) — resolve every finding B) Fix only Critical + High ({critical_count + high_count} issue(s)) — skip Medium and Low C) Skip — keep the report, apply no fixes

step.goal: Apply fixes to QA report files
step.action: Determine issues to fix: Choice A → fix ALL issues Choice B → fix only Critical and High issues

For each issue selected for fixing: QR-1 → re-run /aiqa-generatereport {suite_name} to regenerate any missing report file QR-2 → recalculate pass rate from junit.xml ({passed_tests}/{total_tests}*100); update the pass rate figure in all 3 report formats QR-3 → recount bug reports in bug-reports/ folder; update the bug count figure in all 3 report formats QR-4 → read all test entries from junit.xml; for each test not listed in the report: add a row to the results table in HTML and MD; add a row to XLSX QR-5 → translate all non-{reporting_language} text in each report file to {reporting_language} QR-6 → parse the HTML; fix any unclosed tags, mismatched elements, or broken table structures QR-7 → for each missing section in the MD report: add the section with appropriate content derived from junit.xml and bug reports QR-8 → add a clearly visible quality gate result to all 3 formats: "✅ PASSED — {actual_pass_rate}% ≥ {min_pass_rate}% threshold" or "❌ FAILED — {actual_pass_rate}% < {min_pass_rate}% threshold" Save all corrected report files.

step.goal: Re-verify fixed checks and report final status
step.action: Re-run ONLY the checks that were targeted for fixing
step.output:
📋 Validation Summary — /aiqa-generatereport
(for each fixed check:) ✅ {id} — resolved: {what was corrected} (for each still failing:) ❌ {id} — still failing: {reason} (for each skipped check:) ⏭️ {id} — skipped (outside selected fix scope)
Pass rate : {actual_pass_rate}% (threshold: {min_pass_rate}%) Quality gate: {PASSED/FAILED}
(if all targeted checks pass:) ✅ All targeted issues resolved. QA cycle complete for suite "{suite_name}".
(if some still fail:) ⚠️ {remaining} issue(s) could not be fixed automatically. Re-run /aiqa-generatereport {suite_name} or edit report files manually.
